regime_context: The detector shows a broad but top-heavy leadership structure in Canada: Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners sit 1-2 with strong scores and >0.7 durability, while 11 of 16 themes are ineligible on the trend gate. Rotation breadth is 56% ('broad') but absorption is low (0.31) and the thesis is not 'one_narrative_dominant', so this is a precious-metals-led tape with weak cohesion rather than a single unifying story. Gate suppression is validated on this market's history (gate_helps true), so the main usable edge here is staying in the still-eligible, trend-healthy leaders and avoiding the long tail of gated-out themes — not calling new winners.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the precious-metals leadership (Silver & Royalties + Gold Miners) expands into a one-narrative structure, i.e. rotation.one_narrative flips to true OR the margin over rank-3 (Base Metals & Copper) widens beyond 1.0 while Base Metals crowding_z rises past 1.5 — either would mark a confirmed healthy handoff deeper into metals rather than a broad risk-on; until then the low absorption (0.31) keeps this a rotation, not a regime.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The top-ranked theme is still above the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) with the strongest durability bar in the group (0.70) and full breadth (1.0), meaning the leadership is cohesive across constituents rather than a single-name spike. The crowding z-score (0.94) is elevated but not flagged as crowded, so this is a trend-healthy leader rather than an overheated one-narrative. The call rests on the one validated leg — the trend gate — plus the coincident breadth signal, not on the rank score itself.
evidence: durability_bar 0.70, highest in the eligible set
breadth 1.0 (leadership not driven by one name)
gate_helps=true (trend gate validated as risk control on this market)
theses.dissent: Precious-metals themes are mean-reverting at the theme level in many regimes, and the detector's own backtest says cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0; an 'overweight' here could be chasing the exact leadership that tops when attention peaks.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (proxy for Silver & Royalties) closes below its 50-day average while the S&P/TSX is flat or up over the same window before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Second-ranked theme is also eligible with a marginally higher durability bar (0.75) than the leader and equally full breadth (1.0). The gap to the leader is small (margin 0.137), so this is a coherent precious-metals complex rather than a clean single-theme call. Lean is overweight rather than avoid because the trend gate and breadth both remain intact; conviction is held low because the two metals themes are highly correlated and this adds little beyond the Silver & Royalties call.
evidence: margin to leader only 0.137 (challenger within reach)
theses.dissent: Gold and silver miners often move as one factor; an 'overweight' on both is double-counting the same precious-metals beta, and if the gate weakens for one it likely weakens for both.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners (via XGD.TO) underperforms the Silver & Royalties theme by 5% before the check-by date while both remain above the trend gate.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: This theme sits at rank 3 with a 1.678 score and is gate-eligible, but it is flagged crowded=true (crowding_z 1.23), the highest crowding in the eligible set. Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — but for a desk note the honest lean on an overheated, still-trending cyclical is 'avoid' rather than 'overweight', since adding into a crowded leader without a durability edge (bar 0.67, below both metals leaders) offers no incremental gate benefit.
theses.dissent: Copper and base metals are the classic reflation/cyclical trade, and a crowded theme can keep trending for months; avoiding it may leave the strongest GDP-beta exposure on the table if the macro backdrop shifts to growth.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 10% before the check-by date while the crowding z-score stays below 2.0.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
